related.title: Thread 無線路徑：ETX 與鏈路成功率
related.titleEn: Thread radio paths: ETX and link success probabilities
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 1120 microsecond 與 4960 microsecond，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 1120 microsecond and 4960 microsecond, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋2.22222222222 expected transmissions與2.43867243867 expected transmissions，建立thread_links.csv、方向別成功率、路徑ETX表，並完成以下驗收：在相同每次時間與能量假設下選A；若單跳速率不同則改用時間/能量加權，不能只比ETX。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 2.22222222222 expected transmissions and 2.43867243867 expected transmissions; create thread_links.csv, directional success rates and route ETX table; apply this acceptance decision: ChooseA only under equal time/energy per attempt; otherwise weight by airtime or energy rather than ETX alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 均勻退避整數0至2^BE-1的平均為(2^BE-1)/2；只估等待，未加入CCA、碰撞與重試。 展開基準式 (2**3-1)/2*320；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：枚舉0..7及0..31，再用首末平均交叉驗證；分清平均等待與最大等待。 將兩條推導一起存入 csma_backoff.csv、CCA結果、平均/最大等待。
從原理 簡化獨立成功率p鏈路需平均1/p次嘗試，多跳路徑ETX相加；未納入競爭、確認損失或非對稱。 展開基準式 1/0.9+1/0.9；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：逐跳計幾何期望再加總；較強第一跳不代表整條路較好，保留第二跳反例。 將兩條推導一起存入 thread_links.csv、方向別成功率、路徑ETX表。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Uniform integer backoff0 through2^BE-1 has mean(2^BE-1)/2; this estimates waiting before CCA, collisions and retries., expand baseline expression (2**3-1)/2*320; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Enumerate0..7 and0..31 and cross-check with endpoint means; distinguish mean from maximum waiting. Save both derivations with csma_backoff.csv, CCA outcomes and mean/max waiting.

Starting from A link with independent success probabilityp needs1/p mean attempts; path ETX sums links, excluding contention, ACK loss and asymmetry., expand baseline expression 1/0.9+1/0.9; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Calculate geometric expectations per link then sum; a stronger first hop does not guarantee the better route. Save both derivations with thread_links.csv, directional success rates and route ETX table.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OneWeb LEO：仰角與平地近似斜距
related.titleEn: OneWeb LEO: elevation and flat-Earth slant-range approximation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 1120 microsecond 與 4960 microsecond，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 1120 microsecond and 4960 microsecond, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋1200 km approximate slant與2400 km approximate slant，建立oneweb_geometry.csv、角度單位表、平地模型限制，並完成以下驗收：以2000 km近似斜距門檻只90度例通過；正式路由或指向必須改用球面星曆。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 1200 km approximate slant and 2400 km approximate slant; create oneweb_geometry.csv, angle units and flat-model limitations; apply this acceptance decision: Only90 degrees fits a2000 km approximate-slant limit; real routing or pointing requires spherical ephemerides.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 均勻退避整數0至2^BE-1的平均為(2^BE-1)/2；只估等待，未加入CCA、碰撞與重試。 展開基準式 (2**3-1)/2*320；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：枚舉0..7及0..31，再用首末平均交叉驗證；分清平均等待與最大等待。 將兩條推導一起存入 csma_backoff.csv、CCA結果、平均/最大等待。

從原理 簡化平地幾何斜距d=h/sin(elevation)只用來教學；低仰角與遠距離時地球曲率不可省略。 展開基準式 1200/sin(radians(90))；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：用直角三角形重建h=d*sin(e)，再列曲率模型所需地球半徑；勿混角度與弧度。 將兩條推導一起存入 oneweb_geometry.csv、角度單位表、平地模型限制。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Uniform integer backoff0 through2^BE-1 has mean(2^BE-1)/2; this estimates waiting before CCA, collisions and retries., expand baseline expression (2**3-1)/2*320; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Enumerate0..7 and0..31 and cross-check with endpoint means; distinguish mean from maximum waiting. Save both derivations with csma_backoff.csv, CCA outcomes and mean/max waiting.

Starting from The flat-Earth approximationd=h/sin(elevation) is instructional; Earth curvature matters at low elevation and long distance., expand baseline expression 1200/sin(radians(90)); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Reconstructh=d*sin(e) and list Earth radius needed for a curved model; do not mix degrees with radians. Save both derivations with oneweb_geometry.csv, angle units and flat-model limitations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
